description: Surgewave Public Benchmark — reproducible G3 throughput + latency runs across Surgewave Native, Surgewave Kafka-wire, Apache Kafka and Redpanda. Install with `dotnet tool install -g Kuestenlogik.Surgewave.Benchmarks` and run with `surgewave-bench public --output results.md`. Standalone tool — intentionally NOT a subcommand of the main `surgewave` CLI so Testcontainers + Confluent.Kafka do not bleed into the broker/operator binary (plugin-first architecture).
